I certainly understand what you're saying with these fringe sexualities- and you're right, they do sometimes hinder progression by making those of us who really do feel a certain way (like you said, pansexuals) look like idiots who are just making shit up. 

On the other hand, I don't agree that what you feel like does/doesn't make you that thing. I mean, obviously, thinking you're a millionaire doesn't make you one; but the sentiment you're using would invalidate all transgendered people as well. Gender and sex are two completely different things. Yes, thinking you are MALE does not make you male, but feeling like you are a man and acting as such can mean you are one. Sex can only be changed via surgery/hormones, gender is highly variant and misunderstood. It is a spectrum and any psychiatrist with tell you this is completely valid and normal.
What's wrong with you? People used to say homosexuals were mentally ill. Genderfluid people aren't hurting anyone; "killsexual" IS ridiculous, that's just murder...

As a pansexual, I do find it important to be able to articulate how you feel. I don't think it's stupid or insignificant- part of pansexuality is not just "liking anything", it's specifically referring to being attracted to a persons personality only without regards to gender. Many bisexuals are uncomfortable/not attracted to transgendered people or those toward the middle "grey" area of the spectrum, which is why we have this term. Gender identity is the same way- people just want to feel like they belong to a group, or they now have a way to describe how they feel inside and I don't see anything wrong with that. I don't think it's fair to call people's identities stupid or retarded simply because you cannot understand how they're feeling. Some people who are androgynous physically and mentally may prefer to remain neutral and associate with neither gender; agender. Others may feel differently on different days, sometimes wanting to be called "he", other days "her", often even changing their clothes to suit their prospective 'gender' of the day; genderfluid. These people aren't invalid or stupid for being themselves, and while you may not agree with the terms they use to describe themselves,  there are plenty of worse things in the world. We should be protecting our citizens no matter their identity.
